commit_message: Cache Animation Preview clip choices off the UI hot path
pr_title: GameEngine: implement ADR 0136 preview residency and streaming
pr_body:
## Summary

Completes ADR 0136 on current main with project-scoped preview residency, asynchronous renderer warm-up, frame-budgeted GPU uploads, stale startup reimport recovery, deterministic residency verification, ADR 0135 reclaim recovery, full atomic import-generation promotion, and revision-stamped Animation Set choice caching.

Animation Preview now reuses parsed clip choices until the assigned Animation Set file generation changes instead of reading and parsing the document on every UI frame.
